title: Yolo Space Hacker
description:
YOLO SPACE HACKER 2 FINALLY AVAILABLE ON STEAM!! !!Take it to the next level

After discovering the basic tools of a pentester in YSH 1, then analyzing files and network traces in Forensic, it's time to tackle the web.

Yolo Space Hacker 2 opens up a whole new playground: an entire planet to pwn.

On the agenda:

• A fully 3D universe, more immersive than ever

• Infiltration, exploration... and even parachute jumping

• Sniper rifles, drones, flags galore

• Even more tools to test, understand, and exploit

• Sweepo

Reserved for the most determined:

→ a map, chests, clues to locate and unlock an Overbike

We look forward to your feedback.

🌍 Hack the planet.

Об игреJoin the Y0L0 Space Hacker Agency, an ethical hacker organisation.
Your first mission: hack into a space station and unravel its mystery.What Happened On Bikini-72? - Explore a 3d Adventure Game
 - Solve puzzles based on real security breaches
 - Crack passwords
 - Intercept and temper with web requests
 - Get passed servers security
 - All of this in a secure environment to learn and improve your skillsReal hacking toolsUse the hacker tools integrated into the game: a terminal, a web proxy, nmap to scan the network, dirb for brute-force attacks on websites, password lists to force authentication, John to crack passwords, reverse shells, privilege escalation techniques...

Once the flaw is found, run a Reverse Shell and get Admin.Where to start?- You know nothing about cybersecurity? That's fine, we're set to tell you everything you need to know! 
We have prepared a comprehensive Cyber-security tutorial for beginners. 
Complete missions, to learn step by step the various techniques used by hackers. You'll probably have to use your brain a little bit, but you'll never get stuck.

- You already know the basics of Linux machines and a bit of programming? That's great, it's going to get really interesting!
description_short: Welcome to our ethical hacker's organisation: we will teach you how to use actual hacker tools (terminal, proxy, reverse shells...) to scan the network, crack passwords, bypass server security and solve the mystery of the Bikini-72 space station.
